projects.name: DocuChat: Retrieval-Augmented AI System
projects.description: A document question-answering application that retrieves relevant passages from uploaded files and uses Gemini to generate grounded answers.
projects.longDescription: Built a retrieval-augmented generation pipeline with automated document chunking, embeddings, and semantic search in Pinecone. Supports PDF, DOCX, and TXT ingestion. A FastAPI backend handles uploads, indexing, and queries, while a React interface lets users explore their documents. The frontend was deployed on Vercel and the Dockerized backend on Render.

projects.name: Tatparya
projects.description: A business analytics workspace that turns uploaded data and plain-language questions into clear findings, charts, recommendations, and shareable reports.
projects.longDescription: Tatparya helps users move from a raw business file to a decision they can explain. Users can upload CSV, Excel, JSON, or Parquet files, review columns and data quality, and ask questions about performance, trends, customers, products, or regions in everyday language. The workspace presents answers alongside supporting visualizations, lets users investigate follow-up questions, and brings findings and recommendations into a downloadable PDF report.

My projects include document question answering, AI-assisted analytics, and multimodal prediction. I’m an AWS Academy Cloud Foundations graduate and was a Top 5 finalist among more than 200 teams at IIIT Surat’s DevHeat Hackathon.
